prompt:
A battle background for a side-on JRPG battle scene (the party will stand on the right, monsters on the left; no characters are drawn), in rich high-resolution 2D pixel art. The world is in an endless night: the sun has vanished and people live by lamplight. Setting: inside a vast ancient WHITE LIBRARY at night (the White Archive). Back (top 42%): towering walls of tall white-painted bookshelves rising into darkness, every book with a blank white spine, a tall arched window with pale moonlight, a gallery balcony with a balustrade high up, loose white pages drifting slowly in the air. Ground (lower 58%): a floor of polished ivory marble tiles with a long faded red carpet running into the distance, a few fallen books and scattered blank pages at the sides, a toppled reading chair at one side. Light: cold pale moonlight and a faint white glow from the drifting pages, blue-violet shadows, quiet and eerie. The ground plane recedes from the bottom edge up to the horizon line at a low 3/4 angle; the middle of the ground (from 55% to 90% of the height, centre and right) is open, fairly flat and uncluttered: space for the battle. Details (rocks, plants, debris) sit at the sides and far away. 
No lantern, no fire in the middle, no people, no monsters, no text, no UI.
Pixel art: every art pixel is 4x4 image pixels (the image is 960 x 540 art pixels), crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, hue-shifted colour ramps (shadows toward violet, lights toward warm yellow), clusters with clear shapes, not a painting.
revised_prompt: Create a 16:9 side-on JRPG battle BACKGROUND ONLY, rich high-resolution authentic 2D pixel art. Setting: the White Archive, a vast ancient WHITE LIBRARY in an endless-night world where the sun is gone. Composition crucial: back/top ~42% features towering white-painted bookshelves disappearing into violet-black darkness, all book spines completely blank white, a tall arched window with pale moonlight, high gallery balcony with white balustrade, a few loose blank white pages floating. Lower ~58% is a receding floor plane viewed at low 3/4 angle, polished ivory marble tiles, a long muted faded-red carpet leading away into distance (keep it mostly in left-center, leaving center-right battle space open). Centre and right ground between 55% and 90% image height must be spacious, level-looking, uncluttered for party and monsters; leave broad open foreground for a game battle. Small fallen books, blank pages and a single toppled reading chair ONLY at the side edges or far background. Atmospheric cold pale moonlight, faint spectral white glow off the floating pages, blue-violet shadows, subtly warm-yellow highlights in hue-shifted pixel ramps. Quiet, lonely, eerie, architectural depth and readable gameplay staging. Crisp square pixels, clear hand-placed pixel clusters, hard pixel edges, no smoothing, no anti-aliasing, no painterly brushwork. Target 960x540 ART PIXELS, 16:9. NO characters, silhouettes, people, monsters, text, symbols, logos, UI, lanterns, or fire.
